On the market, a very popular book is Winston and Horn's "LISP".  The
Student Information Processing Board at MIT also publishes "Notes on the
Programming Language LISP", by Bernie Greenberg, which is used as the
course notes for the SIPB's Radical Introduction to LISP course.  For
this, send a request and $2.50 (if a check, make it out to "SIPB") to:

	Cambridge, MA 02139
